scope: Bounded real-book frozen-vision decoder-LoRA pilot with validation-only selection; never final-data access
base_candidate: Reuse the exact hash-bound M5.9.9 retained base raw outputs and rescore with current frozen picture-aware semantics; do not rerun or repair base.
candidate_policy: Train one six-update trajectory and save/evaluate exact checkpoints after steps 3 and 6. No adaptive steps, retries, hyperparameter search or training-loss selection.
selection: Require all three outputs for every candidate. Rank by most fully accepted validation pages, then fewest total Markdown character edits, then fewest total word edits; exact ties prefer base, then the earliest checkpoint. Training loss and final results never select.
picture_policy: validation-005 uses the separately frozen complete picture/text reference, exact source-region asset verification and IoU >= 0.8. Other pages use strict normalized Markdown plus ordered structure. All failures score as empty.
resource_policy: Recompute full frozen-vision features per update and release them; retain every loss/output/failure. Ceilings are acceptance checks, not allocator hard limits. One foreground Metal child only.
final_policy: The runner must not read, render or infer on final pages. Persist and validate a selection seal against book-final-workflow.lock.json; final review is a later workflow.
